key_insight: SevenNet-Polar extends equivariant graph neural networks to predict Born effective charges alongside energy, forces, and stress, enabling fast charge-aware materials simulation without losing accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The model makes electric-field and polarization-driven simulations practical at much larger scales, supporting more realistic screening and dynamics for battery and perovskite materials.
method: Built on the SevenNet architecture with equivariant GNN design for tensor-aware prediction.
Trained multitask models to predict energy, forces, stress, and BEC in the same framework.
Added FlashTP acceleration to scale inference to multi-GPU and large-atom simulations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports BEC RMSE as low as 0.0043 e for single-task models and 0.0029 e for multitask models, with energy/force/stress errors of 1.0 meV/atom, 12 meV/angstrom, and 0.05 GPa, respectively.
watch_item: Generalization is strong on the reported test cases, but performance may still depend on coverage of rare structural environments and on the availability of representative high-temperature or defect data.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
